title: Order
description: Canonical order schema v1 (SIE-24). Covers both directions (sale and purchase) on one model. Produced by manual entry, voice extraction, or image extraction; confirmed by the user before it drives stock and VAT invoicing.

confidence.description: Extractor confidence for this field, 0 (no confidence) to 1 (certain). Absent for manually-entered fields.

money.description: A non-negative monetary amount in the order's currency. v1 only ever populates whole VND (no subunit).

catalogItemId.description: Set when this line matches an existing catalog item. Null for an item not yet in the catalog; name/unit/price below are still a full snapshot either way.

unit.description: Free-form unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "thùng", "cái"). No controlled unit list in v1.

taxRate.description: VAT rate for this line, as a fraction (e.g. 0.08 for 8%).

taxAmount.description: VAT amount for this line, as confirmed (not re-derived from taxRate at read time).

confidence.description: Per-field extractor confidence for this line.

direction.description: Set from the contact at order creation. Immutable after.

status.description: pending: extracted or drafted, awaiting review. confirmed: locked; fires the stock-update and VAT-invoice-eligible events. No further edits once confirmed in v1.

contact.description: Snapshot of the customer or supplier at order time, so later contact edits or deletion never retroactively change a historical order.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. v1 only ever populates "VND".

subtotal.description: Sum of item qty * price, before tax.

sourceLanguage.description: Language of the capture (voice or scanned text). "mixed" covers mixed Vietnamese/English speech in one capture. Not applicable, but still required, for manual entry; set to the UI language.

confidence.description: Per-field extractor confidence for order-level fields.

confirmedAt.description: Null while status is pending. Set once, when status moves to confirmed; a confirmed order cannot be edited in v1, so this never changes again.
